full_prompt_en: A square dark fantasy painting presents a heavily armored guardian in a horned skull-like helmet before a great engraved circular halo. The figure stands nearly front facing but turns slightly to the side, one hand holding a tall staff and the other resting near the elaborate chest armor. Curved horns and a long pale bone mask rise above layered metal plates. Weathered silver, antique gold, and soot-dark steel cover the armor, with embossed details and small scratches catching the light. A dark cape falls over one shoulder and disappears toward the lower frame. Small stone animal figures flank the guardian at the base, making the central body feel monumental. The circular disk behind the head bears fine concentric ornament and gives the composition a solemn, ceremonial symmetry. Most of the background remains near black, so the metal relief and pale helmet carry the viewer's attention. Soft, directional warm light skims across the upper edges, while deep shadows settle in seams and recesses. The painting combines meticulous object detail with smoky, brushed transitions in the dark areas. The mood is ancient, severe, and sacred rather than chaotic; the whole frame reads like a weathered mythic portrait carved out of metal and stone.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形暗黑奇幻绘画呈现一位身披重甲的守卫：头戴长角骷髅状头盔，立于巨大的镌刻圆形光环前。人物几乎正面站立，身体略向一侧转，一手握高杖，另一手停在复杂胸甲旁。弯曲的角与长长的浅色骨面具高于层叠金属板甲。风化银色、古金色和煤黑钢色覆盖铠甲，浮雕细节与小刮痕接住光线。深色斗篷越过一侧肩头，向画面下缘消失。两只小型石兽位于守卫脚边，使中央身体更显纪念碑式的体量。头后圆盘带有细密同心装饰，赋予构图肃穆的仪式对称。背景大多近黑，因此金属浮雕和浅色头盔抓住视线。温暖而有方向的柔光掠过上方边缘，深影落入接缝与凹处。绘画兼有细密物件描绘和暗部烟雾般的笔刷过渡。气氛古老、严厉、神圣，而非混乱；整幅画像由金属和石头雕出的风化神话肖像。
style_prompt_en: A monumental dark fantasy painting language combines meticulous engraved detail with smoky painterly shadow. A central vertical form stands before a large circular ornament, giving the composition ceremonial gravity. Antique gold, weathered silver, bone ivory, and soot-black remain restrained, with warm raking light catching raised edges and embossed marks. Deep recesses stay nearly black, making texture and metal relief legible through contrast. Small side elements establish scale without competing with the center. Brushwork can soften the peripheral darkness while the focal surfaces retain scratches, patina, and layered material weight. The result is ancient, solemn, and tactile, with a clear hierarchy and no glossy fantasy-game sheen.
style_prompt_zh: 纪念碑式的暗黑奇幻绘画语言将细密雕刻细节与烟雾般的绘画阴影结合。中央垂直形体立于大型圆形装饰之前，赋予构图仪式感。古金、风化银、骨白与煤黑保持克制，温暖的侧掠光照亮凸起边缘和浮雕笔迹。深凹处几乎全黑，使金属起伏凭借反差清晰可见。细小侧边元素建立尺度，却不争夺中心。外围黑暗可用笔刷柔化，焦点表面则保留刮痕、包浆和层叠材质的重量。整体古老、肃穆、可触，层级清楚，没有油亮的奇幻游戏质感。
theme_en: A horned armored guardian before an engraved golden halo
theme_zh: 镌刻金色光环前的长角铠甲守卫
name: Adrian Smith
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
